description: This Java source file defines the class UnknownChannelException, which extends DittoRuntimeException. It represents a specific exception thrown when a certain channel is not supported in combination with a particular signal type within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter module. The class includes static factory methods and a nested builder class for creating instances of this exception with detailed context.
